cmd: cd /opt/trading-bot && systemctl show wallbot -p ActiveEnterTimestamp | cut -c1-80; ls -la --time-style=+%H:%M wallbot.py | cut -c30-80; ls *.db | head; for d in ob_wall*.db; do echo $d; sqlite3 $d "select count(*) from events where kind like 'short%'; select datetime(ts,'unixepoch'),symbol,kind,info from events where kind like 'short%' order by ts desc limit 5; select count(*) from open_pos" 2>&1 | cut -c1-200; done; journalctl -u wallbot --since '-30min' --no-pager | grep -i 'перезап\|error\|Traceback' | tail -5 | cut -c1-200
